value: Function main with parameter is not permitted, it should be inlined
note: The symptom of #4307 is the *wording and location* of the diagnostic, not the rejection itself. The reporter accepts that the construct is illegal; the ask is that the compiler say why. So the predicate is the literal generic message quoted in the issue body -- 'main.hlsl:11: error: Function main with parameter is not permitted, it should be inlined. Validation failed.' -- anchored on the distinctive clause and left free of the path/line prefix and the trailing 'Validation failed.', which the driver adds. A match means the diagnostic quality complained about in 2022 is unchanged. This is a positive predicate, so the 'absence clause satisfied by a failed parse' trap does not apply. The #3055 trap does apply in its benign direction: a build that emits a *better*, more specific diagnostic scores no-match, which is exactly what 'the enhancement landed here' should look like. Controls: variant-control-no-readback (the same shader with the read of the output member removed) must score no-match, proving the predicate is keyed to the construct under test and not to mesh shaders, /Od, or entry-point parameters in general.
